progress.context: Screen-reader text for the onboarding progress dots; {current}/{total} are numbers

next.context: Primary button that moves to the next onboarding page

welcome.title.context: Greeting on the first onboarding page

language.hint.context: Small note under the four language cards

audience.title.context: Question above the Brother / Sister cards

audience.brother.context: Card: the user is a man

audience.sister.context: Card: the user is a woman

audience.help.context: Why the app asks (07 A1); reassuring, short

privacy.stored.context: Privacy row 3 — exactly what the server stores (05 §2); keep every item

privacy.policy.context: Link to the full privacy policy

privacy.grievance.context: Link to the grievance officer details

privacy.draft.context: Badge on the draft privacy policy (05 §10)

privacy.offline.context: Shown when the app could not register yet (offline); not an error

masjid.body.context: Explains the masjid poster QR and the code under it

masjid.scan.context: Primary button opening the camera scanner

masjid.code.context: Button to type the follow code

followed.context: Toast after following the masjid from the link that opened the app; {name} = masjid name

followFailed.context: Toast when the masjid from the link could not be added (offline / not found)
